-- public.vw_desembolsos_cr source
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_desembolsos_cr AS WITH desembolsos AS ( SELECT mlt.loan_id, mlt.amount, mlt.transaction_date, mlt.outstanding_loan_balance_derived, mn.note, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY mlt.loan_id ORDER BY mlt.transaction_date) AS primer_desembolso, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY mlt.loan_id ORDER BY mlt.transaction_date DESC) AS ultimo_desembolso, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY mlt.loan_id ORDER BY mlt.transaction_date DESC, mn.id DESC) AS ultimo_con_nota FROM m_loan_transaction mlt LEFT JOIN m_note mn ON mlt.id = mn.loan_transaction_id WHERE mlt.transaction_type_enum = 1 ), cte_transaction_disburment AS ( SELECT d.loan_id, sum(d.amount) AS total_desembolsado, min(d.transaction_date) AS fecha_primer_desembolso, max(d.transaction_date) AS fecha_ultimo_desembolso, max( CASE WHEN d.ultimo_desembolso = 1 THEN d.amount ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS monto_ultimo_desembolso, max( CASE WHEN d.ultimo_desembolso = 1 THEN d.outstanding_loan_balance_derived ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS ultimo_saldo_pendiente, max( CASE WHEN d.ultimo_con_nota = 1 THEN d.note ELSE NULL::character varying END::text) AS ultima_nota FROM desembolsos d GROUP BY d.loan_id ), cte_disburment AS ( SELECT d.id, d.loan_id, d.expected_disburse_date, d.disbursedon_date, d.principal, d.net_disbursal_amount, d.is_reversed, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.loan_id ORDER BY d.disbursedon_date) AS rn FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d ), cte_data AS ( SELECT ml.account_no AS identificador_cuenta, ccp."Cedula" AS numero_identificacion, to_char( CASE WHEN NULLIF(ctd.fecha_ultimo_desembolso::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(ctd.fecha_ultimo_desembolso::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ctd.fecha_ultimo_desembolso::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(ctd.fecha_ultimo_desembolso::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ctd.fecha_ultimo_desembolso::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS fecha_valor_transaccion, to_char( CASE WHEN NULLIF(mldd.disbursedon_date::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(mldd.disbursedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(mldd.disbursedon_date::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(mldd.disbursedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(mldd.disbursedon_date::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS fecha_desembolso, ml.principal_amount AS monto_prestamo, ctd.total_desembolsado AS monto_desembolsado, ctd.monto_ultimo_desembolso AS monto, ctd.ultimo_saldo_pendiente AS monto_disponible, ia.codigo_promotor, ia.codigo_promotor_original, ctd.ultima_nota AS notas, 'Desembolso'::text AS tipo, mpl.name AS nombre_prestamo FROM m_loan ml JOIN m_client mc ON ml.client_id = mc.id JOIN campos_cliente_persona ccp ON mc.id = ccp.client_id LEFT JOIN "Informacion Adicional" ia ON ml.id = ia.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_product_loan mpl ON ml.product_id = mpl.id LEFT JOIN cte_disburment mldd ON ml.id = mldd.loan_id AND mldd.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN cte_transaction_disburment ctd ON ml.id = ctd.loan_id WHERE ml.product_id = ANY (ARRAY[12::bigint, 13::bigint, 14::bigint]) ) SELECT identificador_cuenta, numero_identificacion, fecha_valor_transaccion, fecha_desembolso, monto_prestamo, monto_desembolsado, monto, monto_disponible, codigo_promotor, codigo_promotor_original, notas, tipo, nombre_prestamo FROM cte_data;
